The '''InfiniVacuum™ Hooverius''' can be used to capture [[Pest]]s from up to 15 blocks away. When used near a pest, it will deal {{stat|dmg|400}} per second to the [[Pest]]. {{Pests}} captured with the '''InfiniVacuum™ Hooverius''' will be sucked up, and can be exchanged at {{NPCSprite|Pesthunter Phillip}} for temporary {{Statname|Farming Fortune}} and various goods at his shop.

Left clicking with the '''InfiniVacuum™ Hooverius''' will create a trail of particles leading to the nearest Pest.

By using Sneak left click you open a GUI allowing you to place vinyls, that offer a higher chance for a certain pest to spawn depending on each vinyl.

{{AN|Stereo Harmony}} works even when offline as long as a vinyl is equipped.

== Trivia ==
*Applying the {{Reforge|Buzzing}} reforge and {{Item|Bookworm's Favorite Book|amount=5}} to the '''InfiniVacuum™ Hooverius''' will make it deal {{stat|dmg|900}}, which is more than the {{stat|Health}} of [[Pests]], allowing the player to one-tap them, also bypassing the {{Item|Earthworm}}'s burrowing mechanism.
**While {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} is mayor, Pests have {{stat|Health|1,200}}, therefore {{Item|Earthworm}}s will still burrow with a maxed out vacuum unless using the {{Item|Hedgehog Pet}}, which doubles damage dealt to pests at level {{level|100}}.
***{{level|100}} {{Item|Hedgehog Pet}} also allows for [[Pests]] to be one-shot without using {{Reforge|Buzzing}}, unless {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} is mayor. This allows players to use {{reforge|Beady}} for extra {{stat|Fmf}} against Pests.
*There is a bug that causes vinyls to randomly disappear from the stereo sometimes. It is believed this may happen when adding multiple vinyls in quick succession.
*The name of this item is probably a reference to the popular vacuum cleaner brand ''Hoover.''
*The {{AN|Stereo Harmony}} ability is likely named in reference to Forever Bound's song ''Stereo Madness'', Widely known as the song of the first level in ''Geometry Dash''.
